headline: Investcorp Growth Opportunity Fund files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Nephrocare
sum: Investcorp Growth Opportunity Fund has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a significant investment in or acquisition of shares in Nephrocare Health Services Limited.
detail: Investcorp Growth Opportunity Fund has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to NSE. This disclosure is required when an investor acquires or proposes to acquire shares resulting in substantial shareholding or change of control. The filing indicates either a completed or announced acquisition event in Nephrocare Health Services Limited, a healthcare services provider operating dialysis and nephrology clinics under the Nephroplus brand.
